user_query: My friends and I are planning a football-themed party. Can you suggest some popular football federations that we can use as themes for our party decorations? We would also like to know the head to head stats and previous encounters between two specific teams. And finally, recommend some hotels near our party venue that offer event spaces.

TaskList.description: Research and list popular football federations for party themes.
Retrieve head to head statistics and previous encounters between two specified football teams.
Search for hotels near the party venue that offer event spaces.
